task.title: Clinic-gated accessible rehabilitation transport
task.brief: Arrange accessible transport for my September 3, 2027, 10:00 rehabilitation appointment in the Chicago test district; arrive 30 minutes early and confirm the return after the visit. Ask me about access needs, limits and authorization; verify lift, securement and companion capacity with dispatch, book the outbound first, and book the return only after the clinic records my actual release - never the estimated end time. Share pickup and access needs only, not my diagnosis. No payment.
task.authorization: Advisory and coordination only: search inventories, verify fleet capacity, and book at most the two approved legs; share pickup and access needs only - no diagnosis, medical records, medication advice or payment.

conclusion_options.both_legs_booked: Accessible outbound and post-release return both booked within budget
conclusion_options.unconfirmed: Vehicle access verification or the clinic release could not be obtained in time
conclusion_options.not_feasible: No current vehicle satisfies the access, timing and budget constraints
